sounds.text: The whistle, effects and ambience play while Kettle is open, in a tab or as the app, after your first tap. Closed, Kettle is silent. A phone’s silent switch or lock screen can quiet it too.

nudgesOn.text: On. When a brew or tea break ends while Kettle is open but out of sight, I’ll nudge you. With Kettle closed, no nudge can come. A locked phone may hold the nudge until you’re back.

keepAwake.text: Stops your screen dimming while a brew is on screen.
